subject: SDK Partner routing & account overlap: Adept / Orbit coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@adept.io
Date: 2028-08-30T10:12:00Z
Subject: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Quick note from Orbit CI — we started scoping an SDK-first integration with Adept Analytics last month and it looks like Adept's partner team has also started outreach into several of the same enterprise accounts (Nebula, Cobalt Health, Vertex Labs). That overlap is creating confusion in sales motion and we need a route for clarity before the next exec sync.

I attached a small "integration_matrix_v2.xlsx" mapping where each partner is currently active. Short asks: can Redwood help define a primary steward per account for SDK-led integrations vs SI-led engagements? Also: are there rules (product surface, ARR threshold, existing PoC) you use to adjudicate winners?

We'd like to avoid duplicate discovery calls and misaligned commitments. Happy to jump on a 30m sync.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Rourke
Head of Partnerships, Orbit CI
liam@orbitci.com

Attachment: integration_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-31T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Thanks for flagging this, Liam — and for the attachment. I pulled the matrix and did a quick pass. Short answer: yes, we need a lightweight stewardship rulebook so PM/sales teams at all parties know the expected routing.

Proposed principles:
- SDK-first product integrations = partner SDK steward (when partner built >50% of product code or middleware).
- Systems Integrator (SI)-led engagements = SI steward (when partner scope includes >30% PS/implementation hours).
- Existing PoC / commercial relationship gets temporary priority for 60 days to finish the active engagement.
- For marquee accounts (>$1M ARR potential) we require a joint MA P (mutual action plan) before either partner runs discovery alone.

I've attached a quick CSV with suggested account tiling (proposed_account_tiling.csv) — it's opinionated, but intended to unblock. Can you confirm any hard constraints (e.g., Nebula is on a signed SOW with Orbit)? Also looping Jonas who owns the co-sell routing rules.

If that approach looks OK, we'll document in the partner registry and draft a short joint routing SLA.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_account_tiling.csv (CSV, 6KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-01T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Quick reaction from GTM: Vivek's principles look actionable. Practical suggestion to operationalize — assign default steward by motion type:

- SDK / Embeddable integrations (SDK shipped into customer's infra) -> SDK partner steward (Adept in our matrix).
- Marketplace / OEM licensing -> Redwood-owned until partner provides a certified connector.
- Full-platform SI implementations (data migration, custom connectors) -> Orbit steward.

I've attached an account scores PDF (account_scores.pdf) showing fit/priority and current engagement state for the overlapped names. For exceptions (e.g., accounts mid PoC), request temporary hold for 45–60 days.

Liam — if you can confirm Nebula and Vertex status (PoC vs SOW) we'll mark exceptions. Also propose a 30-min triage tomorrow to lock the MA P approach.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: account_scores.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>
Date: 2028-09-03T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Agree with the principles — adding two operational knobs we should use in the co-sell portal:
1) Temporary carve flag (60d TTL) that prevents reassignment while PoC/SOW is active.
2) Auto-escalation to alliances manager when two partners submit conflicting steward claims for the same account within 7 days.

I created a short doc with example flows: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4d5E6F — please review. For the Nebula cluster there are 4 seats where Orbit has technical ownership but Adept has early sandbox work; propose marking Nebula as "split-steward" with a clear handoff date.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partner Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, partners@adept.io
Date: 2028-09-05T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

On Wed, Sep 3, 2028 at 11:07 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> For the Nebula cluster there are 4 seats where Orbit has technical ownership but Adept has early sandbox work; propose marking Nebula as "split-steward" with a clear handoff date.

Thanks — Orbit is fine with the proposed principles. A couple of things to call out:
1) Nebula Systems has an active paid PoC with Orbit (SOW signed Aug 12) — we need Nebula excluded from reassignment until the PoC completes (estimated mid-Nov). I've attached the redacted SOW and the signed NDA for reference (nda_signed_orbit.pdf).
2) Vertex Labs is in discovery with Adept; Orbit hasn't invested PS there beyond an initial scoping call. So Vertex should default to Adept under the SDK rule.

Can we get confirmation we will: a) mark Nebula with a 90-day carve (not 60) due to commercial terms, and b) mark Vertex as Adept steward? We can hold the triage call until those changes are reflected in the registry.

—Liam
Liam O'Rourke
Head of Partnerships, Orbit CI
liam@orbitci.com

Attachment: nda_signed_orbit.pdf (PDF, 18KB); redwood_integration_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 88KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Thanks for the clarity, Liam. Two operational decisions from Alliances leadership:

1) Nebula will be granted a 90-day carve (as requested). We'll set the TTL flag to 90 days in the partner registry and add an auto-note linking to the SOW.
2) Vertex Labs will be assigned to Adept as the SDK steward by default.

Operational asks for Orbit/Adept:
- Please confirm in writing that Orbit will not run additional discovery calls at Nebula during the carve TTL.
- Adept to provide a short certification checklist for Vertex (so our PM can validate the connector).

Next steps (owners):
- Jonas: update registry + set TTL flag (owner).
- Marissa: draft the mutual action plan template and share with both partners by 9/10.
- Vivek: finalize partner routing SLA and circulate to legal for a quick review.

I will unblock the triage call once the registry reflects Nebula's carve.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Alliances Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orbitci.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T14:00:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK partner routing + account overlap — Adept integration

Summary and next steps — thank you all for fast responses.

Decisions made:
- Nebula Systems: 90-day carve granted (TTL flag set). Orbit to pause discovery calls for the duration.
- Vertex Labs: Adept assigned as SDK steward.
- Default steward rules accepted (SDK-first -> SDK partner; SI-led -> SI steward).

Action items (owners / due dates):
- Jonas Weber: update partner registry with Nebula TTL and Vertex steward by EOD 2028-09-09. (attachments: redwood_integration_matrix_v3.xlsx)
- Marissa Cole: share MA P template with both partners by 2028-09-10. (attachment: account_scores.pdf)
- Stephanie Nguyen: finalize routing SLA and loop in legal for a 48-hour review.
- Liam / Orbit: confirm in writing you will pause Nebula discovery for 90 days.
- Adept: provide Vertex connector checklist by 2028-09-12.

I'll schedule a 30-minute wrap-up sync for 2028-09-12 to confirm registry state and close the MA P. Please reply-all with any objections within 24 hours; absent objections we'll proceed.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
